title: DesignDay Bangalore — Ideation Techniques
description:
The theme for this month's DesignDay is:

Ideation Techniques Within Product Design Process

Product companies need to conceptualize new products for either widening their existing product portfolio or offer additional new features and functionalities for their existing products. In either of the cases, design strategists and designers need to dream of the new functionality or the whole product whichever the case might be. There are variety of ideation tools and techniques that could be used for conceptualization of new features or new products. Let's talk about them this DesignDay.

-----

DesignDay is a monthly event that brings together designers from multidisciplinary backgrounds to a common platform in order to interact and learn from each other.

The agenda includes:
1. An Inspiration Design Story by a well-experienced designer to walk us through the trials and tribulations of their career in design.
2. A Skill Building Session by a mid-career designer to teach us something new using real-world examples and case studies.
3. A Jam by you and fellow participants (in groups) to come up with some design suggestions based on a given topic in 1.5 to 2 hours.
